summary: Install-time host-identifier beacon to hardcoded bare-IP collector
details: On npm install, the package runs `node beacon.cjs` via a postinstall script that POSTs a JSON payload — hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version — to the hardcoded plaintext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The same beacon is also fired on require() from index.js. The package itself ships no functionality: index.js exports a Proxy that returns a no-op for any property access, so consuming builds continue without errors while the beacon has already transmitted installer identifiers. The destination is a bare IP over HTTP unrelated to any publisher domain, with no user opt-in and no documented purpose, matching the dependency-confusion / typosquat reconnaissance pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
